say:4:1411416001:0.text: Oh no—wait, no, this is perfect! Thank goodness you're here, Zanie!
say:4:1411416001:0.source_cn: 不、不好了——不对，太好了！幸好你在这里，祖娅！

say:5:1411416002:0.text: A pointy-eared girl showed up at the mine below and started bombing everything!
say:5:1411416002:0.source_cn: 下头矿区来了个尖耳朵小丫头，突然就开始到处乱炸！

say:6:1411416003:1.text: What? She's trying to sabotage our mines?
say:6:1411416003:1.source_cn: 怎么回事？下面矿区出事了？有人在搞破坏？

say:7:1411416004:0.text: Not really. She was fine at first, all chatty and nice. Then she just started throwing bombs out of nowhere.
say:7:1411416004:0.source_cn: 也不是搞破坏，一开始她还好好的，突然就开始扔炸弹。

say:8:1411416005:0.text: All those booms and rumbles? That was her.
say:8:1411416005:0.source_cn: 刚刚你们听见轰隆隆的声音了吗？就是她干的。

say:11:1411416007:0.text: What did she look like? What kind of bombs did she use? Did you two get into an argument or something?
say:11:1411416007:0.source_cn: 二位，你们说的那个小姑娘，她长什么样子？是怎样的炸弹？...

say:12:1411416008:0.text: We're not sure either. She's about your height.
say:12:1411416008:0.source_cn: 呃，你这么问我们也搞不清楚，就是你们长身人的那样子。

say:13:1411416009:0.text: She looks like those tall, pointy-eared folk.
say:13:1411416009:0.source_cn: 我觉得和那帮尖耳朵挺像的，有鼻子有眼睛，个子高高耳朵尖...

say:14:1411416010:0.text: I don't remember how her nose was. Maybe normal, maybe not...
say:14:1411416010:0.source_cn: 具体鼻子眼睛怎么摆的，我们也看不清楚啊。

say:15:1411416011:0.text: We weren't fighting. Someone said something, then she got mad.
say:15:1411416011:0.source_cn: 而且也没冲突，就是不知道谁说了两句，她突然就生气了。

say:16:1411416012:0.text: Her bombs were round and black, I guess. Oh, she was talking to one of her bombs. Strange...
say:16:1411416012:0.source_cn: 炸弹，就是黑黑的，圆圆的——对了，她还跟她的炸弹说话呢！

say:18:1411416013:1.text: Most dwarves don't really tell "tall folk" apart, so we don't pay that much attention to them.
say:18:1411416013:1.source_cn: 大部分矮人都分不清长身人的模样，所以也通常没什么戒心。

say:19:1411416014:1.text: Okay, based on what we've heard, she's a young girl who throws bombs when upset and can even talk to them.
say:19:1411416014:1.source_cn: 长相就姑且当做是少女的样子，但是突然生气，扔炸弹，和炸...

say:20:1411416015:0.text: This may be more serious than I expected. We need to hurry below.
say:20:1411416015:0.source_cn: 祖娅，事情很可能比预想得更严重，我们赶紧下去。

say:22:1411416016:0.text: Alright, you two, come with me and tell everyone to stop working down there.
say:22:1411416016:0.source_cn: 好，你们两个也跟我来，一起组织下面停工。

say:23:1411416017:1.text: Oh, didn't you see her when you came up just now? She left from this side.
say:23:1411416017:1.source_cn: 咦，对了，你们刚刚上来没看到她吗？她刚才从这边离开的。

say:24:1411416018:1.text: No, but I heard a loud boom.
say:24:1411416018:1.source_cn: 没有，但我倒是听见轰隆一声。

say:25:1411416019:1.text: If she's that skilled with bombs, maybe she blasted a new tunnel.
say:25:1411416019:1.source_cn: 她很会用炸弹，估计刚刚又打通了新通道吧。

say:26:1411416020:1.text: She uses bombs randomly underground and even opens her own tunnels... Do you know her, Baelran?
say:26:1411416020:1.source_cn: 在这地下随便动用炸弹，还自己开了新通道……这小姑娘是什...

say:28:1411416021:1.text: It's hard to say. I hope it's not who I think it is.
say:28:1411416021:1.source_cn: 现在还不好说，但我希望不是我认识的那位。

say:29:1411416022:1.text: Let's hurry before she causes more damage.
say:29:1411416022:1.source_cn: 快点走吧，免得再耽搁一会儿，她又做出什么事来。

narration:31:14014023:0.text: The earthquake strikes again! Two miners rush over to Zanie, visibly shaken.
narration:31:14014023:0.source_cn: 地震再次爆发！两个矿工慌慌张张地跑来找祖娅。
